task.title: Split remote-sync benchmarks by topology
task.description: Refactor workbook-bench so remote synchronization scenarios can be selected and run independently against deterministic local bare remotes at a minimum workload of 500 active tasks with 20 operations per task. Cover: fresh checkout to populated remote; populated local repository to empty remote; both sides already synchronized; five local-ahead and five remote-ahead refs on disjoint tasks; divergent tips; malformed current tips; and buried semantic checkpoint corruption reserved for the exhaustive validator benchmark. Add a --scenario selector, retain JSON and Markdown reports, verify canonical and tracking refs plus per-task outcomes, support SHA-1 and SHA-256, and prove Git-process counts do not grow with task count or history depth. Acceptance targets: fresh checkout <=5s and <=20 Git processes; initial publication <=5s and <=20; already synchronized <=1s and <=10; small changed-ref set <=2s and <=20; divergence or malformed-tip detection <=2s and <=20. Record the current implementation once; a timeout is lower-bound evidence. Do not tune sync behavior in this story or iterate until targets pass.
